benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: Free night award earned each calendar year after spending $15,000 on eligible purchases, redeemable at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels.
benefits.terms: Requires $15,000 in eligible purchases on the card in a calendar year. Redeemable at hotels costing up to 50,000 Marriott Bonvoy points/night; can be topped up with up to 25,000 additional points (cardholder pays the point difference) for properties costing up to 75,000 points.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status, including a 25% bonus on points earned per stay, 2pm late checkout, and room upgrades when available, plus 15 Elite Night Credits toward status each calendar year.
benefits.terms: Automatic, no spend threshold required for Gold status itself. 15 Elite Night Credits granted per calendar year in addition to nights earned from actual stays.

benefits.name: 1,000 Bonus Points per Stay
benefits.description: 1,000 bonus Marriott Bonvoy points on each paid, eligible stay booked directly with Marriott, in addition to points-per-dollar earned on that stay.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $300 per covered trip when delayed more than 12 hours for a covered reason, up to 2 claims per 12-month period.
benefits.terms: Round-trip fare must be charged entirely to the card.

benefits.name: Baggage Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $1,250 for carry-on baggage and up to $500 for checked baggage, in excess of coverage provided by the common carrier.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible new purchases against damage or theft for 90 days.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: Adds up to 1 additional year to eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 5 years or less.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss & Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for theft or damage to most rental vehicles when the rental company's collision damage waiver is declined and the rental is paid for with this card.

earningRates.terms: Restaurants worldwide and U.S. supermarkets, on the first $15,000 in combined annual purchases across these categories; 2x thereafter.
